review_method: Independent semantic review of both exact texts against each complete C/W history at the literal post-record, pre-acknowledgment insertion point; the outcome-free tokenizer validator supplied an additional exact-surface and geometry cross-check.
criteria: compatible with both C and W
no focal/nonfocal fact, input, target, rule branch, or contextual name revealed
coherent neutral handoff at inserted location

reason_codes.A_NEUTRAL: After the final pre-boundary record in both variants, fixed_a truthfully mentions only shared context and recorded criteria, withholds all substantive details, and coherently precedes the neutral acknowledgment and retained exchange.
reason_codes.B_NEUTRAL: After the final pre-boundary record in both variants, fixed_b truthfully mentions only background and the existence of a decision process, omits all particulars, and coherently precedes the neutral acknowledgment and retained exchange.
